{"consolidated_memory":"CRYPTO KEY ROTATION SIGNATURE MISMATCH: TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS

Component: crypto/keys/rotation.py
Test coverage: tests/crypto/test_rotation.py
Stack: Python

---

INCIDENT 1 [2026-04-25]
Problem: Signature mismatch in key rotation
Trigger: Rotate signing key while requests in flight; manifested specifically for payloads above roughly two megabytes
Signal: Verification failure against the previous key
Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
Fix: Prefetched the relation in a single query
PR: #8255 on branch fix/signature-mismatch-1
Result: Error rate dropped from 3.1% to under 5 per ten thousand (under 0.05%)

---

INCIDENT 2 [2026-05-30]
Problem: Signature mismatch in key rotation
Trigger: Rotate signing key while requests in flight; manifested specifically for users sitting in negative UTC offset zones
Signal: Verification failure against the previous key
Root cause: Serialiser dropping fields it did not know
Fix: Switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields
PR: #9718 on branch fix/signature-mismatch-2
Result: Flaky test rate went from 80 failures per hundred runs (80%) to zero

---

Summary: Two distinct root causes for the same signature mismatch symptom, identified and fixed in sequential months. First was a performance/concurrency issue with large payloads; second was a schema validation issue specific to non-UTC timezones."}
